title: Joash Repairs the House of the Lord
description: King Joash decided to repair the House of the Lord after Athaliah and her sons had desecrated it. At the king's command, a chest was placed outside the temple gate where the people gave silver according to Moses' instruction. The silver was used to pay stonemasons, craftsmen, and smiths, and the temple was rebuilt according to its original measurements. As long as Jehoiada lived, regular burnt offerings were brought into the House of the Lord.
